build_kinematics_from_urdf: build a Kinematics object from a URDF file and finger tip link names
compute_forward_kinematics: compute end-effector positions and velocities from joint positions and velocities
compute_inverse_kinematics_one_finger: compute inverse kinematics for a single finger given a target tip position
compute_inverse_kinematics_all_fingers: compute inverse kinematics for all fingers given target tip positions
review_Kinematics_class: review the Kinematics class forward and inverse kinematics methods for correctness
